initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table establishes an observed risk difference of -0.10, but supplies no causal identification design. Request the archived design record R293-2 to assess whether the average causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The observed conditional-risk difference is -0.10, but the design record supplies no condition identifying the causal effect. Consistency and no interference alone do not uniquely determine E[Y(1)] minus E[Y(0)].
